checks.sequence: IMASK15 -> GD lock -> stop receiver -> release reader port -> owned provider transaction -> verify/release -> loan_end -> unlock
checks.result: No unmasked GD caller can observe the native temporary owner; VC2 control race does not generalize to this route.

checks.sequence: claim under saved-SR guard -> storage_deferred -> unlock for I/O -> accept real pending request tokens -> loan_end clears deferral and wakes driver
checks.result: Ordinary controls reach core dispatch; accepted new reads retain metadata without accessing SCI until loan ends.

checks.sequence: immutable copied request -> PENDING -> RUNNING outside guard -> verified provider result -> DONE -> identical protocol retry consumes result
checks.result: BUSY promises no acquisition; changed jobs cannot discard completion; uncertain provider result or poison prevents success ACK and requires restart.

checks.sequence: marker invalidate+sync -> payload+sync -> commit marker+sync -> base+sync -> exact readback -> port restore -> loan_end -> final protocol ACK
checks.result: No ACK before full durable result and verified release. Protocol RESET does not clear storage fault.

checks.sequence: refuse active protocol/worker/mailbox -> stop live Maple work -> retire owner -> terminal reload
checks.result: Native refuses protocol.active; CE additionally refuses commit_attempted and non-IDLE queue. No accepted save is silently discarded by terminal return.

checks.sequence: deferred worker only -> current owner/context -> per-block CRC on hit -> durable commit success invalidates tag
checks.result: Cached data cannot bypass provider quarantine or retain pre-commit block data after success.

execution.boundaries: Existing independently authored SPI/SR/stack/loan models; production mailbox/protocol/provider/SD/store code. No hardware scheduler, analog SPI timing or console boot is modeled.

existing_capability_gap.description: CE protocol endpoint deliberately excludes RESET/KILL; documented existing scope, not newly discovered regression. Native durable endpoint supports RESET without clearing fault.

conclusion: No second supported production defect found in this bounded lifecycle audit. Preserve91fa package unchanged; do not infer universal console compatibility from these checks.
